title: Boss: the address plan
summary: Calculate, validate and aggregate a real address plan.

steps.title: The plan
body: The network team hands you a block, a plan, and a routing table to clean up. Helpers `ToUInt`, `FromUInt` and `MaskOf` are given in each starter.

steps.title: Subnet report
prompt: Write `string Report(string cidr)` (prefixes up to /30) producing exactly four lines joined with `\n`:
starter: uint ToUInt(string ip) => ip.Split('.').Aggregate(0u, (acc, o) => (acc << 8) | uint.Parse(o));
uint MaskOf(int prefix) => prefix == 0 ? 0u : uint.MaxValue << (32 - prefix);
solution: uint ToUInt(string ip) => ip.Split('.').Aggregate(0u, (acc, o) => (acc << 8) | uint.Parse(o));
uint MaskOf(int prefix) => prefix == 0 ? 0u : uint.MaxValue << (32 - prefix);
uint net = ToUInt(parts[0]) & mask, bc = net | ~mask;

steps.title: Validate a plan
prompt: Write `List<string> Validate(string block, List<string> plan)` checking each planned subnet in order and reporting **at most one** problem per entry:
1. `"{c} misaligned"` if its address isn't its own network address (e.g. `10.0.0.32/26`);
2. else `"{c} outside {block}"` if it isn't fully inside the block;
3. else `"{c} overlaps {earlier}"` for the first **earlier** entry it overlaps.
starter: uint ToUInt(string ip) => ip.Split('.').Aggregate(0u, (acc, o) => (acc << 8) | uint.Parse(o));
uint MaskOf(int prefix) => prefix == 0 ? 0u : uint.MaxValue << (32 - prefix);
solution: uint ToUInt(string ip) => ip.Split('.').Aggregate(0u, (acc, o) => (acc << 8) | uint.Parse(o));
uint MaskOf(int prefix) => prefix == 0 ? 0u : uint.MaxValue << (32 - prefix);
(uint Net, int P) Parse(string c) { var s = c.Split('/'); return (ToUInt(s[0]), int.Parse(s[1])); }
if ((c.Net & MaskOf(c.P)) != c.Net) { problems.Add($"{plan[i]} misaligned"); continue; }
if (c.P < b.P || (c.Net & MaskOf(b.P)) != (b.Net & MaskOf(b.P))) { problems.Add($"{plan[i]} outside {block}"); continue; }
if ((o.Net & m) == (c.Net & m)) { problems.Add($"{plan[i]} overlaps {plan[j]}"); break; }
template: Dojo.Eq("problems", new List<string> { "10.0.0.32/26 misaligned", "10.0.1.0/26 outside 10.0.0.0/24", "10.0.0.64/27 overlaps 10.0.0.0/25" }, Validate("10.0.0.0/24", dojoPlan));
Dojo.Eq("bigger than block", new List<string> { "10.0.0.0/23 outside 10.0.0.0/24" }, Validate("10.0.0.0/24", new List<string> { "10.0.0.0/23" }));
hints: Inside the block: prefix at least the block's, and agrees on the block's bits.

steps.title: Aggregate a routing table
prompt: Write `List<string> Aggregate(List<string> routes)` that shrinks a route list without changing what it covers:
- drop any route contained in another;
- repeatedly merge two **sibling** routes (same prefix p, identical in the first p-1 bits) into one /(p-1);
Return the result sorted by network address, as CIDR strings.
starter: uint ToUInt(string ip) => ip.Split('.').Aggregate(0u, (acc, o) => (acc << 8) | uint.Parse(o));
uint MaskOf(int prefix) => prefix == 0 ? 0u : uint.MaxValue << (32 - prefix);
solution: uint ToUInt(string ip) => ip.Split('.').Aggregate(0u, (acc, o) => (acc << 8) | uint.Parse(o));
uint MaskOf(int prefix) => prefix == 0 ? 0u : uint.MaxValue << (32 - prefix);
var set = routes.Select(r => r.Split('/')).Select(p => (Net: ToUInt(p[0]) & MaskOf(int.Parse(p[1])), P: int.Parse(p[1]))).Distinct().ToList();
var keep = set.Where(x => !set.Any(y => y != x && y.P <= x.P && (x.Net & MaskOf(y.P)) == y.Net)).ToList();
if (keep.Count != set.Count) { set = keep; changed = true; continue; }
for (int j = i + 1; j < set.Count && !changed; j++)
var a = set[i]; var b = set[j];
template: Dojo.Eq("contained route dropped", new List<string> { "10.0.0.0/24" }, Aggregate(new List<string> { "10.0.0.128/25", "10.0.0.0/24" }));
Dojo.Eq("non-siblings stay", new List<string> { "10.1.1.0/24", "10.1.2.0/24" }, Aggregate(new List<string> { "10.1.2.0/24", "10.1.1.0/24" }));
Dojo.Eq("halves merge", new List<string> { "192.168.0.0/23" }, Aggregate(new List<string> { "192.168.0.0/24", "192.168.1.0/24" }));
hints: Represent routes as `(uint Net, int P)` tuples.
Siblings: same P and `(a & MaskOf(P - 1)) == (b & MaskOf(P - 1))`. Loop until nothing changes.
